mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicate a synchronized monetary-labor policy environment that accelerates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS < 1.0 and UNRATE < 4.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 470,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 470000) reflect robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 470000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (INDPRO > 100) indicates expanding manufacturing output that enhances corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,250 thousand units (HOUST > 1250) signal strong residential construction demand that precedes economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1250, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS declining), the Federal Reserve's accommodative policy reduces risk-free rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during monetary easing cycles, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 145000) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicates a tight labor market that fuels consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 145000 and UNRATE < 4.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
